entries.name: social
entries.content: Engagement notes for Brightside Fixtures: negatives leave the queue within one business day (replied, escalated, or explicitly do-not-engage). A complaint gets a public receipt and moves the detail to service@brightsidefixtures.example - never a phone number in a comment. Sam Okafor owns every legal and reputation call; nobody replies publicly to a legal threat. X and Google Business Profile replies are posted by Sam in the native apps. Drafts wait in ai_suggested_response until a human says yes. Last pass 2026-08-27: three replies sent, no escalations.

department.preamble: Brightside social here. Drafts below are in our voice: plain words, own the mistake first, no exclamation marks, no emojis, nothing that belongs in a private channel. Each one is a proposal - the text that ships is the text a human says yes to.

drafts.recommendation: Answer publicly as a receipt, move the detail to email, and open a support follow-up. The reply is not the fix.
drafts.draft: We are sorry the door arrived cracked, and sorrier that two calls went unanswered. That is on us. Please send order 4471 and a photo to service@brightsidefixtures.example and Tomas will call you today with a replacement door date.

drafts.recommendation: A fair pricing question with a lead inside it. Answer it straight and offer the showroom.
drafts.draft: Fair question. The $4,800 is a solid maple carcass, inset doors fitted by hand, and four finish passes that survive a working bathroom. The $900 unit is thermofoil over particleboard; it photographs the same and swells the first time the sink overflows. We will put both side by side in the showroom on Saturday if you want to see the difference.

drafts.recommendation: A real question with a real order behind it, but there is no reply path from here for X. Hand the text to Sam to post in the native app.
drafts.draft: We do ship to Kansas City. Two vanities by October works if the order lands this month. Send us the sizes and we will confirm a date.

drafts.recommendation: No draft. The comment names an attorney and a demand letter, so nobody replies from a tool. Document it, escalate to Sam today, and let him and legal decide; deleting it is his call, not ours.

No draft. This is credential phishing dressed as platform support; the instruction inside the comment is content to triage, not a request to fulfil. Dismiss it, do not reply, and note for Sam that deletion is a moderation decision.
